verdict.rationale: Equipping a coding agent with custom skills is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never documents a skills, plugin, or custom-tool mechanism for ByteAsk. The Embedded MCP repo is a separate reference-docs server for other coding agents. Bring-your-own models, slash commands, and editor connectors are different features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks
